# Knowt

> > Knowt is an all-in-one AI learning platform providing flashcards, study notes, and exam prep tools for students and educators across all subjects.

Knowt offers comprehensive study resources including AI-powered tools for summarizing PDFs, videos, and lectures, along with extensive exam preparation materials for AP, SAT, ACT, and IB exams. The platform serves both individual students and schools with FERPA/COPPA-compliant bulk licensing options.

## Exam Preparation

- [Free Resources for Every Major Exam - Study Guides, Flashcards](https://knowt.com/exams): Exam prep hub with guides for AP, SAT, ACT, IB and standardized tests
- [AP Hub Resources: Notes, Study Guides & Practice Exams](https://knowt.com/exams/AP): Comprehensive AP exam prep with notes, guides, and free practice materials
- [AP Practice Test Room - Free Practice Exams for Every Subject](https://knowt.com/exams/AP/practice-test-room): Free unlimited AP practice tests with multiple choice questions
- [AP FRQ Room - Free Response Questions for Every Subject](https://knowt.com/exams/AP/frq-room): AP free response question practice with AI-graded explanations
- [Most Accurate AP Score Calculators for 2026](https://knowt.com/exams/AP/score-calculator): AP score calculator predicting exam results based on past curves

## AI-Powered Study Tools

- [AI PDF Summarizer | Built for Students | Works for Long PDFs](https://knowt.com/ai-pdf-summarizer): AI tool to summarize PDFs and generate flashcards from documents
- [AI Video Summarizer | Built for Students | Works for Youtube Videos](https://knowt.com/ai-video-summarizer): AI summarizer for YouTube videos with flashcard generation capability
- [AI Lecture Note Taker | From Lectures to Notes in Seconds](https://knowt.com/ai-lecture-note-taker): AI note-taking tool that converts lectures into organized study notes
